newsitem.title: POLAND: German firm to buy stake in Polish paintmaker.
newsitem.headline: German firm to buy stake in Polish paintmaker.

text.p: Germany's Ultramarinfabrik Schindlerwerk is likely to become a strategic partner in Polish paintmaker Polifarb Kalisz SA, which is part of National Investment Fund (NFI) No. 6, a fund official said on Tuesday.
"The German firm is likely to become a strategic investor in Polifarb Kalisz. This will most likely occur by a new share issue (by Kalisz)," fund director Piotr Oskroba told Reuters.
Kalisz will hold a shareholders meeting on May 22 at which it will decide on the new share issue.
NFI 6 in Poland's mass privatisation programme also goes by the name Magna Polonia. @
Polifarb Kalisz holds less than five percent of Poland's paint and lacquer market seen worth about 1.3 billion zlotys.
